title: alnus incana var. tomophylla
intro: Alnus incana var. tomophylla, commonly known as the white green alder, is a variety of the green alder tree native to Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to support cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Alnus incana var. tomophylla include analgesic, antiseptic, and vulnerary effects, making it a potential treatment for wounds and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
